params.body:
Follow-up to #1006, from the trial of the own cut-out service on real photos (the `photos_sample` read of #1007).

On 200 photos of the last 90 days the broad CLIP question (outside / interior / detail, threshold 0.9) let 13 through that are not a whole car: six dashboards with a screen, where the screen reads as "outside" through the windscreen, and seven details (a headlight, a taillight, a flank, a bumper, a roof rail). Those are exactly the photos u2net cuts badly, while remove.bg degrades gracefully on them. Every one of the 63 whole cars passed, and the result on those is on a par with remove.bg.

The gate now asks CLIP a second, finer question that names the confusions: whole car / seats / dashboard or screen / one part / open boot. A photo is cut only when the broad question says outside (>= 0.9) and the finer one says whole car or open boot (>= 0.7). The rule was fitted on those 200 and confirmed on a fresh 200 with another seed: wrongly cut went from 12 to 2 (a window and a windscreen photographed from outside, where u2net keeps most of the frame anyway), no whole car was lost, open-boot shots with the rear of the car in view still pass.

- `services/cutout/cutout/gate.py`: `WHOLE_PROMPTS`, `Verdict.whole` and `whole_threshold` (default 1.0 / 0.0 so a one-question stand-in keeps its verdict), `CUTOUT_GATE_WHOLE_THRESHOLD` (0.7).
- `services/cutout/tests/test_gate.py`: both questions must pass; a one-question verdict stands on the broad answer.
- README: the gate paragraph and the new setting.

No PHP changes; the contract of `/cutout` is unchanged. pytest: 14 passed. The real gate was run on four known photos from the second sample: a screen and a taillight kept, a whole car cut, an open-boot-only shot kept.
params.title: Cut-out gate: a second, finer question before cutting
